title: Jets look to show offensive effectiveness wasn’t a fluke in Week 2 test vs. Packers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets look to show offensive effectiveness wasn’t a fluke in Week 2 test vs. Packers
sources.description: No one is going to confuse them with the Greatest Show on Turf just yet, but in Week 1, the Jets offense was competent. Can they repeat that in Week 2?
